methods.label: Count equally likely outcomes
methods.explanation: The tree diagram has \(2\times2\times2=8\) equally likely outcomes. Exactly 2 heads occur in 3 outcomes: (heads, heads, tails), (heads, tails, heads), and (tails, heads, heads). The probability is 3/8.
methods.levelReason: Counting the ordered outcomes and applying the favorable-over-total rule are appropriate Grade 9 probability reasoning.
